lines: Tamsin: Surprised? Murk Hollow's lamp can mind itself a while. These folk needed a lamp keeper.
Tamsin: Ash in the lamps, ash in the tea. Cinderfold is down the slope. Mind the steps.
Tamsin: The kiln glow is warm again, not angry. You can see it from the platform.
Tamsin: Every lamp in Ashmere is lit tonight. I lit half of them. Don't tell anyone.

rail_sign: Down: Cinderfold. Up the ridge: the Kiln Rift. East: the Saltglass flats.

lines: Halvard: Ysolde's apprentice. She wrote you'd come. I'm Halvard, master of this hall.
Halvard: I engraved a plate of Veydal for Mirela once. Copper holds a place still.
Halvard: Two Rifts tear at Ashmere, the Kiln and the Glass. Behind them lies the far end of the Wide Rift.
Halvard: And Veit Harrow works at my old bench. He asked for copper. A lot of it.
Halvard: The Kiln Rift is up the ridge, the Glass Rift past the Saltglass flats.
Halvard: Both Rifts mended. Then the path to the far end is open. And Veit knows it.
Halvard: That plate would have stilled half the world. Go, apprentice. Bring her back, or don't. But go.
Nella: I'm learning to engrave. Every line has to be right the first time. Copper doesn't forgive.
Nella: The Spirlings here just stop. Mid-step. We call it the Stilling.
Nella: My Kindlop wagged its tail today. First time in a month!
Nella: I'm engraving your path through Ashmere. Every line, the first time.
Oswin: The spring under the basalt never freezes. Rest here as long as you like.
Oswin: Mirela rested here once. She sang to the water. It still hums some nights.
Veit: You followed me. Good. Then hear it from me before Halvard tells you wrong.
Veit: The plate is nearly done. Don't try to stop me.
Veit: Twenty years ago the Hush took my Ash. A Mirkmole, the size of a loaf. It walked into a Rift.
Veit: I'm engraving a plate of the Wide Rift. When it's done, the Rift will be still. Gone.
Veit: ...All of it? Nobody asks for all of it.
Veit: I called him every night for a year. Then every week. Then I stopped, and I hated myself.
Veit: The plate stills everything behind the Rift. The Hush. The Echo. Your grandmother too, maybe.
Veit: Join me. Two cartographers could finish it in a week.
Veit: You haven't even heard me out. Fine. Then hear the offer.
Veit: Help me engrave it. Or stay out of my way.

veit_offer_no: Veit: Then we'll meet at the plate.
Kestra leans in the doorway. She heard every word.
Kestra: ...Good answer. I was going to throw a boot at him otherwise.
veit_offer_wait: Veit: Think fast. The copper is cooling.

lines: Kestra: Ash, ash, ash. Tatter hates it. Me too.
Kestra: I've been thinking. Not open, not sealed. A gate. With a keeper on the other side.
Kestra: I'll be at the far end of the Wide Rift. Come find me before you go in.
Tovan: My father Harl held this Rift forty years. I've held it four. Half closed. Half.
Tovan: My Spirlings stopped moving a week ago. Don't look at them like that.
Tovan: Closed. All the way. Father would have laughed. He never laughed.
Tovan: I sleep through the night now. The kiln only glows when I light it.

tovan_intro: Tovan: You want to mend it? I've tried for four years. Show me you're not just another hot head!
tovan_defeat: Tovan: ...Calderox moved. It turned its head to look at you.
Tovan: All right. Hold that edge, I'll draw the other.

lines: Ilse stands at the Rift's edge. Her lips move, but no sound comes.
Ilse: Listen. A new verse. Mirela taught it to me in a dream, I think.
Ilse: Sing it in the Undrawn. It's the part that answers.
Ilse: I sing at the lighthouse every evening. The flats sing back.

ilse_intro: Ilse looks at you without a word. Her Leviarch rises out of the glass.

lines: Ilse: ...Oh. I can hear myself. I'd forgotten my own voice.
Ilse: Help me, quickly. Then I'll teach you something.
THE SALTGLASS LIGHTHOUSE
The lamp is cold. Salt glass has grown over the lens like frost.
THE SALTGLASS LIGHTHOUSE
The lamp burns. Its light runs all the way across the flats to the Rift.
Veit stands over a copper plate as wide as a door. The Wide Rift is engraved on it, line for line.
The bench is empty. Copper filings glitter on the floor.
Veit: One last line and it's done. Everything behind the Rift goes still.
Veit: Two Rifts left open, and you come bothering me? Mend them first, apprentice.
Veit: ...You're good. She'd be proud.
Veit: The plate is still here. One blow and it cracks. Or one line and it's finished.
Veit holds the hammer out to you.
Veit looks at the hammer a long time. Then he brings it down.
Veit: ...Ash would have hated it anyway. Too shiny.
You bring the hammer down. The plate cracks clean through the middle.
Veit: ...So that's it. Twenty years, in one blow.
Veit: I'll come to the far end. Not to stop you. To see. If Ash is in there...

veit_plate_bye: Veit: Don't follow me. I need to be somewhere without maps for a while.

lines: Kestra: So this is the far end. It hums. Tatter's humming with it.
Kestra: Go on. I'll be right behind you, or right here. Either way.
Kestra: Before you go in, one more. Not to stop you. Just... one more. For the road.
Kestra: Ha. Still can't beat you. I've stopped minding.
Kestra: You're really going in there.
Kestra: ...You mean it? Then Tatter and I walk on your left. Always.

kestra_3_wait: Kestra: Okay. Someone should keep the way back open. I'll be good at that.

lines: Kestra: Here. My old compass. It points at whatever you're looking for. Mostly.
The air at the Rift's far end is thin as paper. With the guild seal, it gives.

echo_a: A hushed Spirling stands at the edge of an unfinished path. Its outline is only half drawn.
echo_b: Voices drift past, none of them loud. Every one is calling a name.
echo_c: The land ends here. Past this point, nothing has been drawn at all.

lines: A small Mirkmole sits in the grass, perfectly still. A worn collar. A tag that is missing.
Ash sniffs at your boots, then looks back down the path. Waiting for someone.
You show it the tag from Veit's desk. Its ears go up.

mirela_wait: Mirela: Sit a while. The Echo will wait for us. It's very good at waiting.
finale_echo_1_lose: The Echo washes over you. Everything goes quiet.

lines: Mirela: The Echo listens. Now someone has to decide how this map ends.
Mirela comes home and the Wide Rift closes for good.
Draw it so?
The Wide Rift becomes a gate. Mirela stays as its keeper.
Draw it so?
Veit stays with Ash as keeper of the gate, and Mirela comes home.
Draw it so?
Kestra: Whatever you choose, I'm with you. I mean it. Tatter means it too.
Kestra: I'm here. Don't make me regret it.

finale_kestra_back: Kestra's voice comes from far behind, at the Rift: 'I'm holding the way back! Hurry!'

lines: Veit steps out of the grey, breathing hard. 'I said I'd come to see. I'm seeing.'
Mirela: Then I'll keep the gate. Tell Aldo I'll write. Every week this time.
The Wide Rift settles into a quiet arch of light. A gate, not a wound.
Veit kneels by Ash. 'Someone has to keep the gate. We'll do it. Both of us.'
Mirela: Then I'm going home. Forty years. Oh, Aldo is going to cry.

finale_after_close: Mirela draws one last line along the Rift's edge. It closes like a book.
Mirela: Rift-born Spirlings will need an anchor bond now. Teach people, will you?

lines: Aldo reads the letter on the dock three times. Then he laughs, and lights the lamp.
Aldo: Every week, she says. I'll hold her to it.

dock_meeting_home: Mirela steps off the ferry. Aldo doesn't say anything. He just holds out his hand.
Aldo: You're late. Forty years. The lamp's been lit the whole time.

lines: Your answer and Mirela's verse fold together. The Echo goes very still, and listens.

finale_song_soft: Your voice wobbles, but Mirela carries the tune. The Echo listens anyway.

lines: Mirela: Forty years, and the kettle is in the same place. Aldo never moves anything.
Mirela: Ysolde cried? Ysolde Rennick? I'd have paid to see that.
A letter on the table, the ink still fresh. It came through the gate.
'Every week, as promised. The Echo hums now. I hum back. Come visit. M.'
The map book lies open on the table. Every page is full, but the last one has a wide margin.
There is room left to draw. There always will be.

undrawn_gate_wait: The far end won't give. Somewhere behind you a Rift is still open.
Mend every Rift and every Rift heart first. Your Goals list shows which.
